t: Track git repo existence per spoke in hub-registry.json — gardener verifies during health scan
description: 2 spokes have no git repo. Registry field git_repo_exists should be set accurately by gardener during health scan.
resolution: Already implemented — git_repo_exists field present in hub-registry.json for all spokes, gardener checks .git directory during health scan
perceive: 1. Read hub/hub-registry.json — check git_repo_exists field per spoke. 2. Read hub/.claude/agents/ozi-gardener.md Step 1 — does it check for .git? 3. Verify emailinator and leadfinder have no .git.
execute: 1. Add to gardener Step 1: check if spoke path has .git directory, record in scan_state. 2. Add git_repo_exists to fleet report per-spoke data. 3. Optionally update hub-registry.json git_repo_exists field from scan results.
verify: 1. Gardener report shows git_repo_exists: false for emailinator and leadfinder. 2. Other spokes show true.

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Ensure git repo tracking in registry is accurate
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: Not creating git repos — just tracking the fact
